access_model: Paid, edition- and license-dependent Salesforce org access; Sales Cloud advertises a 30-day trial, while Developer Edition is free for testing and development. mcp_status: Salesforce documents Hosted MCP Servers as available for MCP-compatible clients. blockers: A Salesforce org and a user with API Enabled permission are required for REST API calls.
Professional Edition requires API access as an add-on; API access is not included in every edition.

API calls are governed by aggregate org-level daily allocations based on edition and license type; Developer Edition is documented at 15,000 calls per 24 hours, while Enterprise/Professional-with-API-access and Unlimited/Performance have license-based formulas.
Hosted MCP standard servers are disabled by default, require administrator setup and per-user OAuth/PKCE, and are intended only for customers with Flex Credits, with possible usage billing.
